chapters.title: First sprouts
chapters.blurb: Print, variables, math, decisions and loops.

lessons.title: Say hello
goals: Use print() to show a message
Make the console say exactly: Hello, garden!

lessons.title: Name your water
goals: Create a variable named water and set it to 4
lessons.starter_code: # Store a number in a variable, then print it

rules.hint: A variable is a name, an equals sign and a value: water = 4

lessons.title: Count the seeds
lessons.starter_code:
seeds = 6
pots = 3
# Print how many seeds you need in total

rules.hint: You can put a calculation inside print: print(a * b)

lessons.title: Sunny or not
goals: Use an if statement to check whether sun > 5
Print Grow! when the condition is true
Use else to print Wait when the condition is false
lessons.starter_code:
sun = 8
# Check whether the sun is bright enough for the plants

rules.hint: Write if sun > 5: and indent its print() line by 4 spaces. Add else: on its own line, then indent print("Wait") by 4 spaces.

lessons.title: Water every plant
goals: Write a for loop that uses range(3)
Use the loop variable to number the plants starting at 1
Print Water plant 1, Water plant 2 and Water plant 3 on separate lines
lessons.starter_code: # Use a for loop to water 3 plants, one line at a time
lessons.expected_output:
Water plant 1
Water plant 2
Water plant 3

rules.hint: Write for i in range(3): and indent the loop body by 4 spaces. Use i + 1 when printing so the plant numbers start at 1.
